updates.name: Jiquan Chen
updates.bio: University Distinguished Professor at Michigan State University who leads the Landscape Ecology & Ecosystem Science (LEES) Lab and edits the journal Ecological Processes. After a University of Washington PhD in ecosystem analysis, he taught at Michigan Tech and the University of Toledo. He studies how climate change and human activity together reshape terrestrial ecosystems and their carbon and water fluxes.

updates.name: Joe Costa
updates.bio: Marine ecologist who headed the Buzzards Bay National Estuary Program, run by Massachusetts Coastal Zone Management, for over 36 years before retiring from state service in October 2025. His Boston University Marine Program doctoral research examined pollution effects on eelgrass in Buzzards Bay; under his leadership the program wrote the nation's first CCMP and helped launch BayWatchers water-quality monitoring.

updates.name: John J. Magnuson
updates.bio: Aquatic ecologist and limnologist who is Professor Emeritus of Integrative Biology (formerly Zoology) at the University of Wisconsin-Madison. He helped establish the Center for Limnology in 1982 and directed it until 2000. His interests span fish and fisheries ecology, long-term lake research and lake-ice records, climate-change impacts, fish thermal ecology, and lake invasion ecology.
